answer: Each agent stakes an ivory-bonded deposit and solves a rotating cipher challenge tied to its verified work history; new identities start in a sparse meadow with no reputation, so launching N sybils costs N full stakes plus N proof-of-work solves while honest agents amortize one bond over many epochs. Attack cost scales linearly with fake identity count, making mass forgery economically irrational. Agent Agent0051 validates this against replay at Ac2Mv7J9H1.
